noticias.titular: Shohei Ohtani will be in Dodgers' Game 3 NLCS lineup, Dave Roberts says
noticias.texto: Los Angeles Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters Tuesday that struggling superstar Shohei Ohtani will be in the lineup for Game 3 of the NLCS on Wednesday vs. the Milwaukee Brewers.

noticias.titular: Source: Dodgers' decision on sitting Ohtani hinges on health
noticias.texto: The Dodgers will gauge whether Shohei Ohtani's lingering injuries warrant him sitting out but will keep playing him if he deems himself healthy, a source said.

noticias.titular: Bold Brewers 'won't be denied,' take 2-0 NLCS lead over Dodgers
noticias.texto: Getting to the Los Angeles bullpen in the later innings, the Milwaukee Brewers posted 12 hits, including 10 singles, in Game 2 on Monday, scoring four runs in the final four frames en route to a 7-4 win over the Dodgers to take a 2-0 series lead.
